question: Can editing-only RL improve strict Raw@1 from the stronger P29 editing specialist by explicitly learning source preservation?

initialization.construction_policy: frozen and unchanged; no construction gradients or evaluation jobs in the small gate

reward.ordering_constraint: a strict candidate scores above every valid non-strict candidate

small_gate.data: frozen P25.1 final editing gate: 20 conditions for each of 10 editing tasks
small_gate.decoding: sampled Raw@1, one repeat, temperature 0.8, top-p 0.95, seed 23501
small_gate.selection: compare checkpoints 5, 10, and 20 against the unmodified P29 editing specialist
small_gate.full_evaluation: not launched unless the small gate promotes a checkpoint

interpretation_boundary: This is genuine on-policy RL for an editing expert. It tests an asymmetric boundary-aware policy, not a single-adapter unified model.
